Espanjalaisten autonvalmistajien valta-asetelma on kääntynyt viime vuosien aikana täysin päälaelleen. Emoyhtiö Seatin varustetasona aloittanut Cupra on ensin itsenäistynyt, sitten painanut kovaa ohi niin vasemmalta kuin oikealtakin emostaan. Siinä missä Cupra valmistaa ja myy jopa hieman radikaalin näköisiä, nuorekkaalle ostajalle suunnattuja ja hieman sportahtavia autoja, on Seat painunut melko lailla koko automaailman harmaavarpuseksi.

Hän ei tyydy pelkästään isänsä tapauksen hyvittämiseen, vaan vaatii isoa muutosta operaattoreiden toimintaan. Näyttelijä Pelle Heikkilä julkaisi Instagram-tilillään torstaina julkisen videon, jossa hän kritisoi teleoperaattori Telian toimintaa kovin sanoin. Heikkilä kertoo saaneensa sattumalta selville, että hänen 86-vuotias isänsä maksoi Telialle kuukausittain yli 120 euroa kanavapaketista. items.summary: Tässä tulee maukas haku. Viikon vakiokierrokselta löytyy muutama oikein maukas haku. Ylivoimaisesti kiinnostavin ideavarma on kohteen 3 kotijoukkue Fulham. Fulham on Valioliigan sarjataulukon jumbona murheellisen näköisellä 0–2–4-saldolla. Pelillisesti se ei kuitenkaan ole ollut lainkaan niin huono, kuin tulokset kertovat. Viimeksikin Ipswichin vieraana 1–2-tappio oli tuloksena täydellinen vääryys. Fulham voitti ottelu maaliodottamat 1,8–1,1, vaikka oli itse pelissä pitkät pätkät johtoasemassa. Ipswich käänsi ottelun 88 ja 91 minuuttien maaleilla 2–1-voitokseen.

items.title: Apache CXF: Inoperative max_age authentication-freshness check in OidcClientCodeRequestFilter
items.summary: Classification: Critical, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Not Defined, CVSSv3.1: 9.1, CVEs: CVE-2026-71575, Summary: The max_age authentication-freshness check in OidcClientCodeRequestFilter was inoperative due to a milliseconds/seconds unit mismatch and an inverted comparison polarity. Any relying party using setMaxAgeOffset to enforce re-authentication would silently accept sessions of any age, bypassing step-up authentication policies. items.title: Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices

By next year, smaller AI models may be able to autonomously self-replicate on all kinds of IoT devices, the company said. Eventually, the capability could enable computer worms, which propagate without requiring human interaction and are capable of infecting unfamiliar IoT devices. items.title: GhostAction Compromises About 1,900 GitHub Accounts, Targets Over 30,000 Repositories
items.summary: The credential-theft campaign known as GhostAction has ramped up, targeting more than 30,000 repositories across 3,000 users and organizations. The spike, according to GitGuardian, was observed on October 8 and 9, 2026. "This resulted from compromising the GitHub accounts of about 1,900 users. It attempted to extract 3,174 secrets from public repositories' CI," security researchers Gaetan Ferry and Guillaume Valadon said. GhostAction is the moniker for a supply chain attack campaign targeting developer infrastructure on GitHub. Originally discovered in September 2025, it involves threat actors…

Help TDS is assessed to be active since at least 2017, offering PHP code templates to partners and affiliates that are installed into compromised websites with an aim to direct unsuspecting users to tech support scams. These scams make use of full-screen browser manipulation and exit prevention techniques to serve bogus Microsoft Windows security alert screens instructing victims to contact a…

items.title: Fake Calendar Invites Target Thousands of Organizations in Microsoft Credential-Phishing Campaign
items.summary: A calendar invite is one of the most routine messages in the modern workplace. It lands in the inbox, asks for a few seconds of attention, and is rarely questioned. Attackers know this, and they are now using fake meeting invitations to steal Microsoft account credentials. We have identified several large-scale phishing campaigns that abuse fake calendar invites to harvest credentials. Some arrive as an .ics attachment (example 1). The company announced the decision in response to discovering that devices purchased from CryptoBilis had been modified to steal seed phrases used to access crypto assets and send them to an unauthorized party over an LTE connection. Ledger sells physical cryptocurrency wallets that securely store private keys used for managing and authorizing digital asset transactions. Following reports of cryptocurrency losses fro…

The agency employs around 1,250 staff, oversees billions in legal funding, and works with approximately 2,000 providers, including barristers, solicitor firms, and non-profit organizations that deliver civil and criminal legal aid services in England and Wales. The operator installed Pawns.app, a legitimate bandwidth-sharing application that lets users earn money by sharing their internet connections, on devices without the owners’ consent. Pawns.app account holders are rewarded for allowing traffic from other users to flow through their network, provided it runs on trusted, non-blocking IP addresses. Threat intelligence company GreyNoise discovered the campaign while investigating suspicious activity…

AUR is a community-maintained, widely-used package index for Arch Linux and derivative distributions that hosts package build scripts (PKGBUILDs) for third-party and proprietary tools, beta, or older package versions that are no longer available via the official Linux distribution channels. The repository has recently become a target of malicious campaigns, including an attack in June in which 400 packages distributed credential-stealing malware with rootkit ca…

items.title: NGINX Fixes 5 Flaws, Including Possible RCE and a TLS Bug That May Skip Client-Cert Checks
items.summary: NGINX released versions 1.30.6 and 1.31.7 on October 14 to fix five vulnerabilities, one of them present in every release since May 2005. There are three memory bugs that F5, the company behind NGINX, says could crash a worker process or possibly let an attacker run code, and each requires a specific configuration to exploit. A fourth lets an attacker forge a TLS session that could get past client-certificate checks, though F5 calls the forgery non-deterministic and beyond the attacker's control. The fifth lets an HTTP/3 client slip extra bytes into a request that NGINX passes on to a backend.…

items.title: Drupal Patches Critical Field UI Flaw With Unauthenticated RCE Path via Contributed Modules
items.summary: Drupal core has a critical flaw in its Field UI module that could let an attacker run code on the site's server, and fixes were shipped on October 14 in Drupal 11.4.10, 11.3.19, and 10.6.19. An attacker cannot reach the flaw through core alone, the Drupal Security Team said in its advisory. Several exploit paths exist through contributed modules, and at least one known path needs no login. Tracked as CVE-2026-108097, the flaw sits in Field UI, the core module behind the admin pages where site builders manage fields and how they display. Drupal rates it 19 out of 25 on its own risk scale, the l…

items.title: Hackers exploit Collabora RCE flaw to backdoor Nextcloud servers

Multiple administrator reports indicate that attacks began in mid-September, roughly a month before the formal security bulletin, the GitHub advisory, and CVE publication. CVE-2026-110447 impacts richdocumentscode versions before 26.4.303 and resides in the Nextcloud app’s mechanism for starting the bundled Collabora server.

items.summary: Harry Kane on päässyt Bayern Munchenin kanssa sopimukseen uudesta pitkäaikaisesta jatkosopimuksesta, kertoo siirtotoimittaja Fabrizio Romano . Englantilaishyökkääjän uusi sopimus ulottuu kesäkuuhun 2029 saakka. Bayern pitää Kanea keskeisenä osana joukkueensa nykyisyyttä ja tulevaisuutta. Seura haluaa rakentaa hyökkäyksensä kokeneen englantilaisen ympärille ja hänen nimensä on noussut myös yhdeksi mahdolliseksi Ballon d’Or -voittajaehdokkaaksi. Kane siirtyi Bayerniin Tottenhamista kesällä 2023 ja on vakiinnuttanut asemansa joukkueen tärkeimpänä maalintekijänä.
